title: Baked Fish Bowl
description: A healthy and flavorful bowl dish with baked fish, nutritious rice, and a hint of Syrian spices.

ingredients.name: Nutritious rice
ingredients.notes: Pre-cooked or cooked according to package

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the fish fillet on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the fish and sprinkle with Syrian allspice, salt, and pepper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
While the fish is baking, prepare the nutritious rice according to package instructions.
Once the fish is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 2-3 minutes.
Flake the fish into large pieces and serve over the nutritious rice.
Drizzle with lemon juice and garnish with chopped parsley.
